# Shah Reuse & Trading Enterprise (SRTE)

> Importer and local wholesaler of sorted used (second-hand) clothing, footwear and household textiles, based in Karachi, Pakistan. Our team imports 15-20 x 40ft containers a month, currently from the USA and Canada, and is seeking long-term supply partners in Europe, starting with Italy.

## Key facts
- Company: Shah Reuse & Trading Enterprise (short name SRTE), Importers & Local Wholesalers
- Head office: Sher Shah, Karachi 75730, Pakistan
- Leadership: Shah Faisal, Chief Executive Officer & Proprietor; Shah Khalid, Partner & General Manager
- Import volume: 15-20 x 40ft High Cube containers a month, 22-26 tons net each; 20ft possible depending on the goods
- Sourcing today: USA and Canada. Expanding to Europe: Italy first, then Germany, Netherlands, Belgium, Poland, United Kingdom, France
- Buys every grade: Cream, A, B, C / mixed, and original (unsorted) loads; also warehouse-clearance and end-of-season lots
- Categories: winter jackets and coats, knitwear, hoodies, children's wear, paired shoes, blankets and household textiles, summer and mixed stock, accessories
- Bales: pressed and marked, 45-55 kg (shoes and accessories 25 kg)
- Payment: letter of credit at sight or documents against payment through the company bank account; never cash or third parties
- Inspection: pre-shipment inspection by SGS, Bureau Veritas or Intertek for first orders, at SRTE's cost
- Ports: Karachi Port (KICT, PICT, SAPT) and Port Qasim (QICT); customs code PCT 6309 (worn clothing)
- Replies to offers within 2 working days; grade and weight report within 14 days of arrival
